programme.title: Pitch Perfect 3
programme.desc: After the highs of winning the World Champs, the Bellas found themselves split apart and jobless. But when they get their chance for one last tour, they come together again.

programme.title: Anger Management
programme.desc: After a case of air rage almost gets him thrown in jail, timid Dave Buznik is court-ordered to attend anger management sessions with a psychiatrist with some very unorthodox methods.

programme.title: Cocaine Bear
programme.desc: An oddball group of cops, criminals, tourists and teens converge on a Georgia forest where a huge black bear goes on a murderous rampage after unintentionally ingesting cocaine.

programme.title: Christmas With The Kranks
programme.desc: Fed up with the commercial aspects of Christmas, the Kranks decide to skip Christmas this year and forgo the gifts, the tree, the decorations and to spend the dollars saved on a Caribbean cruise.

programme.title: Happy Gilmore
programme.desc: Happy doesn't just play golf, he destroys it. With the help of a retired golfer and hot publicist, can Happy perfect his game and tame his temper to win the tournament prize money?

programme.title: The Hangover Part III
programme.desc: The third and final instalment in the comedy smash hit. This time, there's no wedding. No bachelor party. What could go wrong, right? But when the Wolfpack hits the road, all bets are off.

programme.title: The Longest Yard
programme.desc: A recently convicted retired football superstar is forced to form a football team of prison inmates to challenge the prison guards.

programme.title: Semi-Pro
programme.desc: The worst team in the renegade American Basketball Association is on the brink of collapse, but can it rebound to salvation?

programme.title: Grown Ups 2
programme.desc: Lenny Feder moves his family to his hometown and looks forward to spending time with his old friends. However, he and his companions soon face bizarre situations and new enemies.

programme.title: The Night Before
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve, three lifelong friends get together for their annual reunion and set out to find the Holy Grail of Christmas parties in New York City.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Ninja
programme.desc: An inept warrior is persuaded by a beautiful woman to embark on a dangerous mission into the wilds of Beverly Hills to protect her from her criminal-minded boyfriend and his Yakuza associates.

programme.title: You Don't Mess With The Zohan
programme.desc: Zohan is the Israeli army's most lethal weapon. But he's tired of fighting terrorists and wants to be a hairdresser in New York, even if he has to fake his own death.

programme.title: American Pie: The Wedding
programme.desc: Stifler takes centre stage in the funniest - and grossest - sequel. Jim finally proposes to Michelle, but nothing goes smoothly in this finale which will keep die-hard Pie eaters coming back.

programme.title: Daddy's Home 2
programme.desc: Having finally gotten used to each other's existence, Brad and Dusty must now deal with their intrusive fathers during the holidays.
